# Synthetic fixture for OBS-13: production gateway collector with no probe filter.
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
  hostmetrics:
    scrapers:
      cpu:

processors:
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_percentage: 80
  batch:
  filter/redis:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_conditions:
      - span.attributes["db.system"] == "redis"

exporters:
  otlp/backend:
    endpoint: tempo.example.com:4317
  debug:

service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, filter/redis, batch]
      exporters: [otlp/backend, debug]
    traces/local:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [debug]
    metrics:
      receivers: [hostmetrics, otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp/backend]

# Synthetic fixture for OBS-13: OpenTelemetry-instrumented workloads with HTTP probes.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 3
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: example/api:1.4.2
          env:
            - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
              value: http://otel-collector:4317
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready?verbose=0
              port: 8080
            periodSeconds: 5
        - name: envoy
          image: envoyproxy/envoy:v1.31
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /stats
              port: 9901
---
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: checkout
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        instrumentation.opentelemetry.io/inject-java: "true"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: checkout
          image: example/checkout:2.0.0
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /actuator/health/liveness
              port: 8081
            periodSeconds: 15
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /actuator/health
              port: 8081
